functional_unit: grams CO2-equivalent per kilowatt-hour of electricity
system_boundary: lifecycle; details and harmonization vary by underlying study and technology
source_locator: IPCC AR5 WGIII Annex III, Table A.III.2

values.scope_warning: The summarized range cannot resolve all land-use, counterfactual, carbon-stock, feedstock, or time-horizon questions; use CLM-SUS-008 for dashboard interpretation.
The extreme range is material; reservoir and site characteristics can dominate.
Small literature and deployment base; do not treat as a commercial-fleet average.

excluded_from_numeric_table.reason: No directly verified comparable IPCC Table A.III.2 row was transcribed in this pass; leaving it absent is preferable to inventing a value.
Results depend on biogenic/fossil fraction, avoided-disposal counterfactual, allocation, and heat-credit choices.
Hydrogen is a carrier; emissions must be calculated from production, storage, transport, leakage, and conversion pathway.
Storage is not primary generation; climate effect depends on manufacture, losses, charging mix, displaced generation, and dispatch.

mandatory_chart_annotations: Values are literature medians and ranges, not 2026 fleet observations or forecasts
Use a logarithmic axis or explicit range treatment so hydropower's upper tail is not hidden
Do not show medians without ranges
Do not combine operational and lifecycle values in one series
Do not infer air-pollution health impact from lifecycle greenhouse-gas intensity

update_path.preferred: Build a versioned coefficient ledger from NLR source-study records and final IPCC/UNECE releases, retaining geography, plant configuration, fuel supply, methane assumption, lifetime, capacity factor, allocation, and system boundary.
update_path.rejection_rule: Reject nonfinal reports marked 'do not cite' and secondary infographics that omit ranges or boundaries.
